mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM whitelist WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_active = 1 AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW())
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO whitelist (user_id, added_by, reason, expires_at, is_active) VALUES (#{userId}, #{addedBy}, #{reason}, #{expiresAt}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE added_by = VALUES(added_by), reason = VALUES(reason), expires_at = VALUES(expires_at), is_active = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE whitelist SET is_active = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT w.id, w.user_id, u.username, u.real_name, w.added_by, w.reason, w.expires_at, w.is_active, w.created_at FROM whitelist w LEFT JOIN users u ON w.user_id = u.id ORDER BY w.created_at DESC
